name: Mexico
shortSummary: Mexico has emerged as a growing trade partner for India, particularly in pharmaceuticals and automotive components, though the relationship remains modest relative to India's other major partnerships.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India is a major supplier of generic pharmaceuticals to Mexico.
Growing two-way trade in auto components.

recentDevelopments.title: Pharmaceutical and auto-component trade grows
recentDevelopments.description: Bilateral trade in generic pharmaceuticals and automotive components continued its steady growth.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A modest but expanding relationship without major political friction.

historicalEvents.description: India and Mexico institute a framework for expanded political and economic dialogue.
